research_rationale:
EO 11658 (Establishment of the Missouri River Basin Commission), signed 1972-03-22. The order establishes the Missouri River Basin Commission (Section 1), fixes its jurisdiction (Section 2) and membership (Section 3: a Chairman, Federal agency members, State members and interstate agency members), its functions (Section 4) and international coordination (Section 5) and reporting (Section 6) sections. Its held text has no sunset or termination provision.  First end: Section 5(a)(5) of EO 12319 (River Basin Commissions, signed 1981-09-09 and published at 46 FR 45591) names Executive Order No. 11658, as amended, among the orders revoked effective October 1, 1981, so the revocation took effect on 1981-10-01. The Federal Register issue text also carries a 3 CFR index entry for this order recording the revocation by EO 12319 with the same effective date (the text layer is OCR with broken letter spacing, so I describe it without quotation). Section 1 of EO 12319 lists the commission established by this order as terminated on September 30, 1981, but it names commissions and not their establishing orders; under the owner ruling on unnamed instruments that is a disclosed earlier candidate and not an end.  Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, 4 hits for this order), the eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 (4 hits) and the Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition-note search (5 hits). They are leads only; the end, the later events and the savings were decided from the held Federal Register texts named in this claim. Search of the held order texts for this order's number (the packet records a bounded number-citation search over its lookup corpus, excluding clause-draft copies): apart from the order's own copies, the matching files are EO 11882, EO 12038, EO 12148, EO 12319.

savings.reason: I read the full held Federal Register text of EO 12319 (46 FR 45591). Its Sections 2 to 4 direct agencies to cooperate in an orderly close-out, transfer commission assets to the member States subject to the approval of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, and direct Federal agency members to continue coordination; none of them preserves the revoked order or any command of it, so I find no saving clause. The asset transfer is a one-time transition arrangement of the commissions, not a command of this order.
